notes.title: Update #3!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!



Today I’m bringing you a content update! We’ve added 52 new cards, along with a brand new and much more organized card pack purchasing system in the store. We’ve also fixed a few bugs—hope you enjoy it!


Bug Fixes and Improvements:
Fixed the stretched player image when winning or losing a match.

Improved visual quality for the “Al Palo” and “Alto” graphics.

Optimized game storage space.


New Mechanics:
Added a new card pack purchasing system in the store.


New Skins:
We’ve added 56 new card skins, including:
[olist]
Full 1-peso deck (excluding 10, 11, and 12).

Full faca-style sword deck (excluding 10, 11, and 12).

Full traditional club deck.

Full traditional sword deck.

Full traditional cup deck.

Full traditional gold deck.

1 of gold (oro) – 2-pesos version.

7 of gold (oro) – 1-peso version.
[/olist]


[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"]

notes.title: Update #2!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!



I received several requests to update the card-playing mechanic, so I made a change — now you can play card vs. card instead of having all cards stacked in the center. I also added a new skin. Thanks for the feedback, and enjoy the game!


Bugs and issues fixed:
Fixed a bug where the "Confident" achievement couldn’t be unlocked.

Fixed a bug where, after buying many custom cards, the lower rows in the customization screen couldn’t be applied.

Various fixes to the borders of some sprites.

Added support for long Envido chains with more than 4, 5, and 6 combinations.

Fixed a bug where, if the score was 1–1 in rounds won, the AI would accept "Vale Cuatro" on the third card even when it knew it couldn't win.

Improved the deck shuffling animation, including side movements and hover effects.


New mechanics:
The way cards are played has been changed — they are no longer stacked in the center but now directly face off against the rival's card.


New skins:
A new skin has been added for the 1 of clubs.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"]

notes.title: Update #1!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!



Have you been enjoying Truco? I hope so! Thank you so much for purchasing the game and leaving reviews. I truly appreciate your interest and support. I want you to know that I'm taking all your feedback seriously and actively working on fixing bugs. I also know that the most requested feature is online mode...



That’s why I’m announcing that online mode is in development! More news will come on that soon.


Bugs and improvements:
Fixed a bug where moving the mouse to the left edge would reveal hidden buttons.

Fixed a bug where the Envido + Envido + “No Quiero” score was calculated incorrectly for the AI.

Fixed a bug where the player’s profile picture appeared stretched.

Fixed an issue where small cards looked blurry in 1920x1080 resolution.

Added the ability to view card hierarchy during matches.

Redesigned the “How to Play” screen for better understanding.

Improved some title texts for clarity.

Adjusted certain sprites for better display across different resolutions.

Fixed scoring for “No Quiero” in 3 and 4 level Envido chains.

Fixed a bug where, after a tie, the next player was not correctly assigned as the hand.

Fixed a bug where tying the first and second rounds didn’t trigger a decisive third round.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"]

notes.title: Official launch! You can now play TRUCO ARGENTINO!
notes.content:
🃏 Official Launch – Version 1.0 is now available! 🃏


After many months of work, testing, tweaking, and long mate breaks, we're proud to announce that TRUCO ARGENTINO is now officially available in its final version 1.0.

This update marks the full release of the game, and we’d love to share with you everything included in this version:


Full Argentine Truco experience
Traditional mode with Envido, Real Envido, Falta Envido, Truco, Retruco, Vale Cuatro, and Flor (if enabled).
AI with unique personalities
Face off against rivals with different playstyles: conservative, aggressive, deceptive, calculating, and more.
You can even let them learn from your moves to become increasingly challenging.

Each AI reacts differently and has distinct chances of calling, accepting, or bluffing.
Full stats & achievements system
Track your win streaks, number of Truco calls, victories, defeated AIs, and more.
Customization system
Buy cards with in-game currency, customize your deck’s design, and switch up the visual style.
Real-time AI reactions
They’ll mock you, praise you, or put pressure on you depending on how the match is going.

Each personality has its own lines and reactions.
Configurable options
Enable/disable Flor, adjust game speed, difficulty, sound, and more.


This is just the beginning.
We’re already working on new features, improvements, and content. Thanks for playing, for the support, and for spreading the word!



📝 Leave your feedback here: https://forms.gle/TQvDGM7EVA7dQJEr6

If you enjoyed it, leave us a review on Steam — it helps us a lot.



See you at the table!

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"]

notes.title: Build your own deck!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Got another update for you: Card Customization is now part of Truco Argentino.
This one's for those who are tired of playing with that busted deck you got at the corner store, and want to bring some real flavor to the game.

Now you can swap out the designs of cards like the 1 of swords, the 12 of cups, or the 10 of gold.
Some feature iconic characters, some have inside jokes, and some... just make a statement.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/69eae31d74c44397758aead6d5afbbcca77cb51a.png"]


How does it work?
Buy new cards in the store using the coins you earn in-game.

View your full deck and see which designs you’ve got equipped.

Head to the Customization menu and build your perfect deck — the one that’s gonna crush your opponent’s spirit.

Everything you buy stays saved. Once it’s yours, it’s yours for good.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/25bc1c40c19f95bff8bfbe680a70b68f2a026bc0.png"]


A deck with personality
You’re not just playing a game — you’re showing who you are.

Wanna call Truco while slamming down the World Cup trophy as your 1 of gold? Put Diego on your 10 of gold? Use the old-school 50 cent coin as your ace? Go for it.

And in the future, you’ll even be able to suggest your own card ideas to be added to the game!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/391c93581ba1f007888f7c4a993b3b58ba986622.png"]


 So when does all this drop?
📅 July 9th, 2025

On Argentina’s Independence Day, you’ll be able to bring your own deck to the table — and play the way you want to.



Add Truco Argentino to your wishlist, send it to that one friend who always claimed they were unbeatable — and get ready.

In Truco Argentino, you don’t just take turns — you play with heart, with voice, and with nerves.



We’ll see you at the table.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"]

notes.title: Are you playing against a machine… or your Uncle Leo?
notes.content:
Hey everyone!
Let’s talk about one of the core things that makes Truco Argentino truly special: How does the AI work?

The short answer? It’s not just some bot. It’s that one cousin who laughs in your face when he beats you — and somehow always gets away with it.

Let’s break down how the AI thinks, reacts, and why every match feels like you're playing against a real person.


Real personality, not just difficulty
Forget about the kind of AI that just throws the highest card.

Here, every bot was crafted with a unique personality — a playstyle, a mindset, and even custom phrases to mess with you.

There’s one that acts shy… until it hits you with a Vale Cuatro out of nowhere.
Another one folds at the first Truco but drives you crazy with Envido.
And then there’s the one that plays like it already saw your cards before the match even started.

We didn’t just want difficulty levels. We wanted characters — rivals you'd love to beat (and maybe fear a little).



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/5aeba1f5538a31d158c047c081d0cb09728d5f57.png"]


So… how does it play?
It reads your style: Play too safe, it’ll pressure you. Bluff too much, it’ll stop falling for it.

It evolves as you play: Strategies shift even mid-round — it doesn’t stick to patterns.

It reacts with intent: Every Truco, every fold, every comeback — it’s thinking.

It talks: Each AI has its own voice and tone. Some polite, some… less so.

And if you enable Adaptive AI, it will learn from you over time.
So be careful what habits you teach it — it’ll use them against you.


A real example?
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/070c9a429008f1ded9fa7e1c8a2b581ed66e6712.png"]


Yes, you get to choose your opponent
You’ll be able to choose who you face from a full roster of bots — each with a name, description, and a defined playstyle.

Feeling bold? Pick the aggressive one.
Having a rough day? Maybe go for the nervous one who folds early.

Each bot comes with a different kind of challenge, and the real fun is figuring out how to beat them all.

We’re also working on a “random rival” mode — because, just like in real life, you don’t always know who’ll sit across from you.


 So when does all this drop?


📅 July 9th, 2025

Yes, Argentina’s Independence Day. And honestly, we can’t think of a better time to let loose, throw some cards down, and yell “Quiero” like you mean it.


What’s coming next?
In the next devlogs we’ll show off:

How you can customize your card deck.

What kind of ridiculous (and glorious) achievements you’ll be able to unlock.



Add Truco Argentino to your wishlist, send it to that one friend who always claimed they were unbeatable — and get ready.

This isn’t just turn-based card play.
This is a battle of nerves, voice, and heart.



We’ll see you at the table.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45618607/2f420d0c800e0ea7801a714639015057dba82138.png"]

notes.title: Welcome to Truco Argentino!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

We’re officially launching Truco Argentino on Steam, and I’d love to tell you a bit about this game — born from the desire to bring all the fun, competitiveness, passion, and energy of how we play Truco in Argentina to your screen.

🎴 What is Truco Argentino?
It’s a faithful version of the classic Argentine Truco, with real rules and AI opponents with unique personalities. You can even let the AI learn from your moves, adding a whole new level of challenge. The goal? To make you feel like you’re sitting at the table with friends. No gimmicks — just the Truco you know and love.

💡 What can you expect from the game?

- Fast-paced, exciting matches
- AI with distinct playstyles that adapt and surprise you
- Stats and achievements to track your progress
- Customizable decks
- Multiplayer coming soon!
- And of course, regular updates

 💡 In this space, we’ll be sharing:

- Development updates
- Improvements in progress
- News, announcements, and surprises

👉 Add Truco Argentino to your wishlist so you don’t miss a thing!

Thanks for supporting this project. See you at the table! 🧉🇦🇷
